title: Data Augmentation
learning_objectives: Write label-preserving augmentations: flips, small shifts and brightness changes
Apply augmentations reproducibly with a seeded generator
Keep augmented images in the valid uint8 range
entry_point: augment(image, rng, max_shift=2); augment_batch(images, seed=0, max_shift=2)
hints: Keep the order of random draws exactly as stated, so results are reproducible.

failure_feedback.advice: Use one np.random.default_rng(seed) for the whole batch and draw in the stated order.
Use small shifts and horizontal flips only, so a horizontal bar stays horizontal.
Scale brightness in float32 and clip to [0, 255] before converting to uint8.
